privacy_description: How AstroDX Community handles sign-in, profiles, analytics and backups, and how to delete your account.
privacy_intro: This notice applies to AstroDX Community at https://adxc.saop.cc. This version provides Google, AWMC, QQ and passkey sign-in, public profiles, account settings and account deletion.
privacy_google: If you sign in with Google, we receive your Google account identifier, email address and name to confirm your identity. The identifier links your sign-in method to your account. The email address identifies the linked account in your account settings. On registration, your Google name may become your public community nickname, which you can change in profile settings. Google sign-in tokens are used during sign-in and are not saved in the community account database.
privacy_qq: When you sign in with QQ, we process your QQ number and any QQ nickname we can retrieve. Bot 3550411407 sends verification codes in private QQ messages. We use the number to deliver codes and link the sign-in method. Your QQ nickname may become your initial public community nickname. If the nickname lookup fails, the initial public nickname is QQ followed by your masked QQ number, keeping the first and last two digits. You can change it in profile settings. Code verification and rate limits use temporary records with an expiry.
privacy_passkey: For passkeys, we store the public key, credential identifier, the name you give the passkey, device type and usage timestamps needed to verify sign-in. Your device or passkey provider handles the private key and any fingerprint, face or other biometric information used to unlock it. The community does not receive them.
privacy_profile: Community accounts also include an ID, nickname, biography, language preference and creation time. Other visitors can see your ID, nickname, biography and creation time on your public profile. Google email addresses, full QQ numbers, sign-in sessions and passkey details are not shown on public profiles.
privacy_session: We use necessary sign-in cookies to maintain sessions. We record session creation, update and expiry times, IP addresses, browser information and regional information for device management and account security. Sessions last thirty days and can be renewed while in use. A scheduled cleanup removes expired sessions.
privacy_preferences: Your browser also saves interface preferences such as language, theme and motion. Operational logs record IP addresses, request paths, request times, response status and duration to investigate faults and prevent abuse. Request logs do not record URL query parameters.
privacy_analytics: When analytics is enabled, our self-hosted Umami processes page visits, referral sources, browser or device type, region, and sign-in and onboarding events. The analytics service processes visitor IP addresses and browser information. Sign-in events include only the sign-in method, without the community account ID. Analytics reports do not forward your sign-in credentials or record URL query parameters or fragments.
privacy_analytics_disabled: When analytics is disabled, community pages do not load its tracking script.
privacy_services: Google handles the Google sign-in flow you select. Tencent QQ delivers bot verification messages. Cloudflare provides site network services and uses Turnstile to process IP addresses, browser information and verification interactions to prevent automated abuse. These services also process information under their own privacy notices.
privacy_manage: You can change your nickname and biography in profile settings. Account settings let you manage linked sign-in methods, passkeys and signed-in devices, and request account deletion.
privacy_delete: In this version, accounts are treated as empty accounts. Once you request deletion, existing sessions are revoked and the account is marked for deletion. A background task is queued immediately to remove your profile, linked accounts, passkeys and session records. This empty-account flow does not provide a seven-day cancellation period.
privacy_backups: Account deletion does not simultaneously remove existing security logs, analytics or historical backups. Originals and databases use local encrypted backups, rotated by seven daily, four weekly and six monthly snapshots; these are retention counts, not a fixed maximum age for every snapshot. Older database-only snapshots remain and cannot restore files. Minimal deletion and revocation records are kept in a separate encrypted journal for seven months. Recovery replays the latest verified journal before reopening public media; unverifiable journals keep media closed. Copies already saved in other browsers or devices may remain after server access is revoked. There is currently no offsite backup.

site_help_upload_body:
Upload a single-chart .adx or .zip, or assemble separately selected chart text, audio and artwork. Follow the file picker instructions and keep each package to one song.
Packages are limited to 64 MiB; the personal quota is 256 MiB including version history. After validation, explicitly save a private draft. Saving does not publish it. Keep your local files while correcting errors.
site_help_publication_body:
Save descriptions, credits, tags and release notes in your private workspace. Select the file version, review its differences from the public version, then explicitly publish. Private edits do not update the public page automatically.
A permanent numeric chart ID is assigned on first publication. Withdrawal or takedown stops new public access, but cannot remove files already saved on another device. Historical file versions stay private unless explicitly selected and published.
site_help_practice_body:
Load preview resources on demand, seek using the density timeline, then set A/B to loop a section. Seeking outside disables the loop; hidden tabs pause looping playback. Changing difficulty or closing clears the range. Speed changes also change pitch.
GIF export is silent at original speed, 480 pixels and 20 FPS, up to 15 seconds. It keeps mirroring but excludes music, artwork and video. Access is checked again before export. Cancel or shorten the range to retry. Preview does not guarantee game import compatibility.
site_help_community_body:
Chart comments belong to the current public file version and may include difficulty/time anchors. Forum topics are independent discussions; linked chart cards become unavailable after withdrawal. Comments and replies are plain text; topic bodies support limited Markdown.
Withdrawing a topic root locks it; others’ existing replies may remain accessible by direct link. Reports require administrator review and do not automatically take content down. Automatically copied report evidence lasts at most 30 days and is cleared earlier when either party’s account is purged. Reporter-entered statements follow private-ticket rules. Notifications stay on site. Account purge clears your discussion text and private notifications; structural placeholders and others’ replies may remain.

discussion_topic_limits: Each account may create 5 topics per 24 hours and retain 200 topics. Topic creation also has a 10-second cooldown; each body allows 5 edits per minute.
discussion_report_limits: Reports share a daily limit of 10 and an open-ticket limit of 20 with chart reports. A target can only be reported once per account.

download_help: Queue charts from details, favorites or lists, up to 50 at once. Tasks lock the public version at creation; updates and withdrawals require confirmation. Only complete files are checkpointed; reloading never resumes automatically. Collections preserve original ZIPs and are not importable ADX files. Browser downloads only confirm a save request; directory writes confirm actual completion. All records stay on this device and are cleared on sign-out or account change.
download_plan_hint: Confirmation starts fixed-version transfers. Large files stay in the queue for directory or original-link saving.
author_scope_hint: Private workspace: importing, reviewing and saving never publish automatically.
author_local_hint: Only plan metadata stays on this device for 24 hours. Refresh pauses work; reselect originals or reconcile server state.
author_persistence_hint: Local recovery unavailable; reselect files after refresh.
author_batch_unavailable: This browser cannot coordinate batch uploads. Use single-chart upload.
author_plan_hint: Up to 10 rows and 256 MiB of raw files; each archive up to 64 MiB. Explicitly choose a new chart or an existing chart for every row.
author_save_selected: Save selected ready rows as private drafts / versions
author_reconfirm: Read latest revision and reconfirm target
author_active_side: Preview this side (pauses and releases the other)
author_source_limit: Fine following exceeded its budget; full source remains available.
author_analysis_failed: Precise preview is unavailable for this difficulty; server import results and source remain available.
author_advisory: Import accepted. Warnings and preview limits are advisory, not additional publication bans.
author_archive_changed: Archive changed; inspected preview assets match. Extra files were not compared.
author_diff_fallback: Fine comparison exceeded its budget or mapping is unavailable. Summaries and both complete source views remain available.
author_history_hint: Compares immutable archives and import summaries. Historical private descriptions, credits and tags were not snapshotted.
author_note_hint: Drafts are editable only; they never save automatically or overwrite existing notes. Review and explicitly save.
author_saved_metadata: Publication uses the saved metadata below. Editing a draft does not alter public content.
author_no_pair: At least two existing private versions are needed for comparison.
author_results_hint: Rows save independently. Check each result; partial success is not batch completion.
author_help:
The creator workbench summarizes your charts, warnings, private changes and capacity. Batch import supports10 rows and256 MiB of raw files, processing one archive at a time. Explicitly map each row to a new chart or an existing chart version, then save ready rows privately. Import never publishes automatically.
Review reads source with the central parser; viewing history does not change the current version. Comparison is owner-only and falls back to summaries and independent source when budgets are exceeded. Review and explicitly save release-note drafts. Publication always requires a separate version choice and confirmation; warnings are advisory.
author_privacy: Import plans keep bounded metadata on this device for24 hours, without original files, source or credentials; they are not server backups. Refresh, sign-out and account changes stop processing. Recovery requires original-file verification or reconciliation with current server results. Review and comparison are session-derived, adding no cloud history or historical public access.
discovery_intro: Find your next chart through creators, lists and discussions.
discovery_search_hint: Search titles, aliases, artists, designers, creators or topics…
discovery_suggestion_failed: Suggestions unavailable. You can still submit a search.
discovery_unavailable: This section is unavailable. Please try again later.
discovery_partial: Some sections are unavailable. Other results are shown.
discovery_random_empty: No playable charts match these filters.
discovery_daily_hint: Rotating public charts, without using your browsing history.
discovery_levels_hint: One level per line, up to 8. Custom levels are preserved.
discovery_tag_hint: One tag per line, up to 5. All must match.
discovery_same_slot: Difficulty, level, designer and duration must match the same slot. Levels are author supplied.
discovery_filters_invalid: Invalid filters. Check the limits and duration range.
discovery_alias_hint: One per line, up to 8, each up to 60 characters. Publish the metadata update to make aliases searchable.
discovery_share_invalid: Invalid share parameters or missing difficulty. Choose a difficulty manually.
discovery_perf_not_run: No controlled performance receipt for this version yet.
discovery_perf_receipt: Controlled check: {date}, p95 {ms} ms (not live latency).
discovery_public_info: Only current public content is searched. Drafts, private libraries and account details are excluded.
discovery_help: Search covers currently public charts, creators, lists and forum topics. Filter by difficulty, tags, declared level, designer, duration and playability; slot conditions must match the same difficulty. Author levels are not official constants. Draft aliases become searchable only after an explicit metadata publication. Difficulty/time links never autoplay and do not preserve withdrawn versions. Random discovery selects from a bounded public candidate window, not uniform sampling. Downloads and library actions use the existing queues.
discovery_privacy: Discovery does not profile browsing, downloading or following behavior, and does not persist raw search terms. Suggestions, counts and feeds use current public content only. Draft aliases, private libraries, email and linked login identities are excluded. Display preferences stay on this device and can be reset by clearing site data. RSS and sitemap reflect current public visibility.
governance_private_hint: Your private decisions and appeals, without reporter information.
governance_ops_hint: Review chart, discussion and list reports in one queue. Counts describe moderation records, not traffic.
governance_no_restore: Review can uphold a decision or request reconsideration. Reconsideration does not automatically restore or publish content.
governance_snapshot_hint: Appeals and activity records use database snapshot backups. Records after the snapshot may be absent following recovery; durable content controls remain effective.
governance_audit_hint: Committed administrative actions are recorded from this release onward, without content bodies or browsing history.
governance_appeal_limit: One appeal per decision; up to 5 open appeals and 5 submissions per 24 hours.
governance_confirm: I have checked this decision and my reason and confirm submission.
governance_submitted: An appeal already exists for this decision.
governance_resolve_confirm: Confirm this outcome and notify the appellant. Content will not be restored automatically.
governance_decision_unavailable: The original decision explanation is unavailable; this appeal remains recorded.
governance_limit: Appeal limit reached. Wait for current appeals or try later.
governance_changed: This record changed. Refresh and check the current outcome.
governance_unconfirmed: Submission is unconfirmed and your text is retained. Check existing records before retrying.
governance_help: Use My moderation center to review decisions and submit a private appeal. Review results arrive in site notifications; reconsideration does not restore content automatically. Administrators manage queues and activity in Governance and operations.
governance_privacy: Appeal text and feedback are private to the appellant and current administrators; appeal text is removed with account purge. Minimal administrative records contain public administrator numbers, targets and times, without bodies, reporter details, IP addresses or browsing activity. These records follow database snapshot recovery.
